source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    !!!! GPU Sensor need to load related driver first under OS. !!!!
1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
4. All PWR_GB_GPU1~PWR_GB_GPU8 should get pass result.

original_test_intent: For each applicable GPU1 through GPU8 power channel, prove a plausible and correctly attributed response to an approved GPU workload, compare it with Project sensor expectations, verify combined-population power behavior, and separately demonstrate any approved threshold-driven fan, throttle, shutdown and event response plus recovery.
original_method: Boot the OS, load the related GPU driver, stress the module and observe sensor changes with `ipmitool sdr elist`. The source does not define the GPU-to-sensor topology, workload, power domain represented by `PWR_GB`, tolerance, or a safe threshold-reaching plan.
manual_activity: An engineer maps every installed accelerator and BMC power channel, approves driver/runtime and device-selective workloads, confirms chassis/PSU/cooling headroom, decides threshold scope and remains present with workload abort and recovery authority.
required_inputs: GPU1~GPU8 logical label to physical slot, PCIe address, device serial/UUID, board/baseboard power domain, BMC sensor/SDR and installed-population map
Definition of `PWR_GB`, units, scaling, update interval, averaging/filtering, idle/load range, tolerance and authoritative Project reference
Validated GPU firmware, driver/runtime and non-destructive workload with deterministic device selection for single-GPU and all-applicable-GPU phases
Per-GPU power cap, temperature, memory/compute health and throttle limits plus chassis input power, PSU redundancy/headroom, rail/connector and cooling limits
Warning/critical thresholds, hysteresis, SEL/event identity, fan/throttle/shutdown expectation and whether threshold crossing is in Project scope
Load ramp/dwell/stop, evidence clock alignment, cooldown/recovery, absent-device reporting and engineer owner
safety_requirements: Preserve the explicit `ipmitool sdr elist` read method when supported and do not invent raw IPMI bytes; any Redfish/vendor alternative is a recorded Project Override and does not prove the IPMI path.
Verify exact device identity and start with idle, then exercise one GPU at a time before any combined phase so swapped, aggregate or cross-coupled sensor mappings are detected.
Before combined load, calculate and approve chassis/PSU/rail/cooling headroom; never assume eight-GPU simultaneous stress is safe merely because eight sensor names exist.
Continuously monitor every present GPU's power, temperature, clocks, throttling, memory/driver/device health, BMC channels, fans, SEL, PCIe status, chassis/PSU power and host/BMC health.
Abort on wrong-device load, power-cap/rail/connector/PSU fault, thermal overshoot, unexpected throttle, GPU/driver/memory/PCIe error, fan anomaly, BMC loss or host instability.
Stop workload through the approved runtime, preserve the first fault, do not clear evidence, reset a GPU/host, power-cycle or auto-retry, and verify full cooldown plus device/driver recovery.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, bind each source label to immutable slot/device/sensor identity, capture idle high-level IPMI readings and synchronized vendor/OS device telemetry, and record absent positions as N/A rather than PASS.

Run device-selected GPU1 through GPU8 workload phases separately, time-align each BMC channel with actual target utilization/power/thermal state, then execute only an explicitly approved combined-population phase.
Calculate per-channel delta, attribution, lag/filter behavior and tolerance; identify aggregate sensors or cross-coupling rather than crediting one active GPU to all eight.

Report dynamic response separately from any actually exercised threshold/event/protection checkpoint, stop and recover through approved software, and do not invent raw bytes, alter firmware/power caps/thresholds, reset devices, auto-retry or issue verdicts.
engineer_actions: Approve GPU/device/sensor/power-domain mapping, installed applicability, IPMI output, driver/runtime/workload versions, device selection and comparison tolerance.
Approve individual and combined power/cooling envelope, abort and recovery, and decide whether any threshold-reaching protection phase is safe and required.
Assess cross-mapping, aggregate readings, power/thermal, GPU/driver/PCIe or protection anomalies and issue per-GPU plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its placeholder is non-runnable and correctly avoids guessing, but the assertion that raw IPMI is required conflicts with the Master high-level `ipmitool sdr elist` instruction. It also omits the necessary workload and device attribution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Validate the exact sensor names in the source high-level IPMI output, then run an approved device-selective GPU workload while collecting synchronized vendor/runtime and platform telemetry. Use another read tool only as a documented Project Override.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The GPU1~GPU8 labels, explicit driver prerequisite, stress action, `ipmitool sdr elist`, script and 5/10-minute estimates remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT EIGHT-GPU SENSOR AND POWER-ENVELOPE PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map all installed GPU power channels, capture idle state, load each GPU individually to prove identity, run an approved combined phase within chassis headroom, correlate filtered BMC power with device telemetry, separately account for protection thresholds, then unload/cool and verify recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact GPU/baseboard topology, installed population, PCIe/rail/PSU/cooling design, BMC/SDR and GPU firmware/driver/runtime stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record GPU model/serial/firmware, slot/PCIe address, BMC/SDR/BIOS, driver/runtime/workload, power-monitor and telemetry versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project GPU topology and power-domain map, BMC SDR definition, GPU/board/rail/PSU/cooling limits and approved workload specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable device identity, single-device causal phases, aggregate-versus-per-device detection, combined chassis power budgeting and explicit recovery while retaining the source read method.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One GPU workload, aggregate board power or a static listing cannot satisfy all eight channels; absent positions are N/A, not passed, and normal load response does not prove threshold protection.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology/population, sensor semantics, driver/workload, tolerance, power/cooling budget and threshold scope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC channels may represent board rails with filtering rather than instantaneous device telemetry; simultaneous accelerator load can exceed PSU, connector or cooling capacity even when individual phases are safe.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may have fewer than eight installed GPUs, a different approved workload or another supported sensor interface. It must preserve the source range as the applicability matrix, mark absent/unexercised positions explicitly, record tool-equivalence limits and cannot claim untested IPMI, devices or protection paths passed.
expected_evidence: GPU1~GPU8 applicability and physical slot/PCIe/device serial/UUID/power-domain/sensor/SDR identity matrix
GPU/BMC/SDR/BIOS/driver/runtime/workload versions, sensor units/scaling/filtering and Project expected ranges/tolerances
unaltered high-level `ipmitool sdr elist` evidence plus synchronized idle and each single-GPU phase showing target and non-target channel/device response
approved combined-population workload with per-GPU and chassis/PSU/rail/fan/thermal/host timeline and power-headroom evidence
per-channel attribution, lag/filter/tolerance analysis and separately labelled threshold/event/protection evidence or explicit untested coverage
workload stop, cooldown, recovered GPU/driver/PCIe/sensor/thermal/power/fan/host/BMC health, preserved first-fault evidence and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target GPU1~GPU8 board-power channels. The meaning of `GB`, physical mapping, installed count and tool output are Project readiness inputs rather than conflicting source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The per-GPU dynamic power purpose is clear. Supported drivers/workloads, sensor mapping, tolerances and chassis limits are supplyable readiness inputs, enabling an attended approved plan with automated stimulus and evidence collection.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the prohibition on guessed bytes but restores the Master's high-level IPMI method and supplies the missing workload/telemetry contract.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes permanent BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 and removes raw-command bytes from the mandatory contract while retaining critical accelerator power safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Corrects its skipped next-row reference and independently adds device-selective attribution, aggregate-sensor detection, installed-population handling, combined power budgeting and threshold-coverage separation.

review_improvement: Makes every installed GPU channel causally attributable and prevents one accelerator or aggregate rail from satisfying eight checkpoints, while preserving source-tool coverage and system power safety.
independent_technical_reasoning: Eight similarly named power channels cannot be validated by a single all-GPU load because mapping swaps and aggregate rails would be hidden. A one-device-at-a-time matrix establishes causality, while a separately approved combined phase checks shared power and cooling behavior. BMC filtering and measurement-domain differences require time-aligned tolerances rather than instantaneous equality with vendor telemetry.
